children: ArriVent BioPharma reported initial Phase 1 data showing a 44.8% objective response rate for ARR-217 in pretreated colorectal cancer patients at the 6 mg/kg dose.
At 6 mg/kg every three weeks, ARR-217 achieved a 44.8% response rate and 93.1% disease control rate in pretreated CRC patients.
At doses of 4 mg/kg and higher, the response rate was 34.2% and the disease control rate was 91.8% in CRC patients.
Across all doses, 30.1% of patients had Grade 3 or higher treatment-related adverse events; no Grade 5 events or ILD were observed.
ARR-217 has advanced to Phase 1b dose optimization at 5 and 6 mg/kg every three weeks, with further data expected in 2027.
